jobs.title: Subcontract Payload Re-Entry System Product Manager 3 - BOSS 12761-1
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a Subcontract Payload Re-Entry System Product Manager 3 . This position will be located in Roy, Utah and will support the Sentinel program.

The Product Lead’s primary responsibilities are to manage the Payload Re-Entry System’s subcontract including the management of cost, schedule, and technical performance. This subcontract involves the design, manufacture, and testing of the Payload Re-Entry Subsystem.

What you will get to do:
• Enforcement of subcontractor execution of a Statement of Work (SOW) and support of contract modifications as necessary
• Risk and Opportunity development and management to include seeking management reserve funding to effectively mitigate program risk
• Resolution of technical and operational problems. Typically accomplishes results through lower level(s) of technical advisement, subject matter experts (SMEs), or focused oversight of the subcontractor
• Evaluation of supplier performance including the development and execution of incentive and award fee plans
• Measuring and reporting program performance through development and adherence to budget baselines utilizing EVMS principles
• Leadership of identification, allocation, tracking, and completion of program requirements. Management of cost, schedule and technical performance of complex projects and dynamic priorities across multiple baselines and operational locations
• Ensuring the team understands and adheres to customer expectations, contract scope, and manages change through control board activities
• Delivering presentations to customers, executive management, and other program stakeholders
• Supporting the preparation and approval of proposals, ROMs, ECPs, specifications, and operating budgets

As a full-time employee of Northrop Grumman Defense Systems, you are eligible for our robust benefits package including:
- Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
- 401k
- Educational Assistance
- Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
- Paid Time Off
- Health & Wellness Resources
- Employee Discounts
This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree and 8 years of experience, or Master’s Degree and 6 years of experience

- Active US Government Secret clearance investigated within the last 6 years and ability to obtain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance

- 2 years of experience with Earned Value Management System (EVMS) principles and application as a Cost Account Manager (CAM)

- 2 years of experience working with a subcontractor in a technical advisory role

- 2 years of experience managing a multi-disciplinary team

- Experience with mechanical design and analysis of metallic structures, avionics engineering, and the design of ordnance systems

These Qualifications Would be Nice to Have:
- Current Top Secret, SCI, and/or Special Access clearance
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Knowledge of configuration management best practices, scheduling, and cost estimation
- Experience performing technical evaluation of supplier proposals
- Subcontract negotiation and definitization
- Experience overseeing subcontracts for performance and accountability
- fast-paced engineering environment
- Experience on Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) or other missile programs
- Experience leading hardware procurement/supply chain operations
- Strong leadership qualities, as well as strong verbal and written communication skills

Primary Level Salary Range: $166,700.00 - $250,100.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

jobs.description:

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Principal Agile Product Owner—Network Team Lead (26-406) to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview:

The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a key component of the Missile Defense System. It is a vital operational system that enables the U.S. president, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at strategic, regional, and operational levels to plan ballistic missile defense operations systematically, collectively monitor the battle, and dynamically control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission goals. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities that enable an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It serves as a force multiplier by networking, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems and operations, both globally and regionally, to improve performance. C2BMC is essential for all ground and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems.

In this role, the candidate will serve as a Network Team Lead. The candidate will coordinate the planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities to develop assigned technical capabilities integrated into the C2BMC Network Enterprise. The candidate will work within an agile team and plan work based on customer requirements and program contractual agreements. The candidate applies extensive expertise to solve complex problems that require regular use of ingenuity and creativity. Work is performed with minimal direction and is reviewed for desired results over a relatively long time frame. Erroneous decisions would normally fail to achieve major organizational objectives.

The Network Team Lead will serve in project leadership roles and represent the organization as the primary customer contact for significant technical matters on contracts. This position is accountable for the capability's overall engineering, technical, cost, and schedule performance. The candidate is expected to maintain clear, open communication with program and engineering management regarding status, staffing needs, and engineering projects. The candidate will drive the use of best practices within the engineering team through Agile processes, tools, and frameworks, and will review capability artifacts and development practices for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer contract requirements, and related specifications.

The candidate will provide input to standard metrics packages used for program execution status, technical improvement, and management/customer status updates. Responsibilities include managing risk mitigation activities, planning schedules, and handling change requests associated with the capabilities. The Network Team Lead will manage the execution of assigned ECP effort(s) added to the capability, coordinate and resolve deconfliction of multiple spiral and capability resources across the Agile Release Train (ART) and with other program ARTs, lead Agile and other planning activities to ensure priority and maturity are achieved, maintain the team's Hive structure and keep it up to date daily, and perform any other required tasks as directed by the program.

Essential Functions:

- Lead an agile network engineering team responsible for development and integration of technical capabilities into the C2BMC Network Enterprise

- Coordinate planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities in accordance with program contractual agreements and customer requirements

- Provide technical leadership across cost, schedule, and performance for assigned capabilities and associated ECPs

- Serve as primary technical interface and customer contact for significant network-related technical matters

- Apply advanced technical expertise to solve complex, multi-disciplinary problems requiring creativity and innovation

- Plan and lead team Agile ceremonies and other planning activities to ensure clear priorities, maturity of work, and alignment across the Agile Release Train

- Review technical artifacts, designs, and implementation approaches for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer requirements, and related specifications

- Develop and provide standard metrics and status reporting for program execution, technical improvement, and management/customer updates

- Manage risk and opportunity, including development and execution of risk mitigation plans, schedule planning, and change request management for assigned capabilities

- Coordinate and resolve resource conflicts across multiple spirals, capabilities, and ARTs

- Maintain and continuously update the team’s Hive structure and related tracking tools daily

- Support planning, execution, and coordination of documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments

- Support program management of strategic technical projects, problem solving, and overall business rhythm to ensure effective and efficient operations

- Perform other duties as assigned in support of C2BMC program and network enterprise objectives

Basic Qualifications:

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

- A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or 12 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
- Applicants must have a current, active Government-Issued 8140 certification at IAT Level II or higher (such as Security+ CE, CISSP, CCNA-Security, CySA+, CND, etc.) at the time of application, which is required to start. The candidate is responsible for maintaining their 8140 certifications throughout the entire contract period
- Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
- Active project management certification such as Project+, CAPM , or PMP (or the ability to obtain within 60 days of start)
- Prior experience as an Information Technology Engineer, preferably in network or infrastructure engineering
- Proven project management experience as part of large DoD systems and capabilities under development
- Experience managing and reporting cost, schedule, and technical development on a large program, demonstrating the ability to coordinate planning, execution, integration, and completion of projects within an assigned area of responsibility
- Experience in planning, conducting, and coordinating activities such as documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments
- Experience managing the design, development, and implementation of complex systems
- Experience with Agile methodology and/or Agile Product Owner practices; experience supporting Digital Transformation and DevOps implementation
- Ability to analyze project, program, and portfolio information needs and determine the resources needed to achieve objectives
- Ability to understand both the long-term (“big picture”) and short-term perspectives of situations and program needs
- Demonstrated experience leading high-performance technical teams, including mentoring, coaching, and performance oversight
- Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and facilitation skills, including the ability to effectively interface with customers, program leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders
- Must be able to travel to alternate work locations as required to execute job duties

Preferred Qualifications:

- Prior C2BMC experience and familiarity with C2BMC NT/BC processes and procedures

- Prior Team Lead and/or Product Owner experience leading Agile teams or technical capabilities

- Experience developing key performance indicators (KPIs), tracking other metrics, and creating reports to support program and customer insight

- Ability to quickly comprehend the functions and capabilities of new and emerging technologies and apply them with complex networked systems

What We Can Offer You:

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that encourages your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, enabling you to choose options that suit your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following:

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for an Internal Only: Sr Principal Software Engineer – SW Product Owner (26-435) to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

NOTE: This position is only available to current and active C2BMC personnel

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview:

The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a critical element of the Missile Defense System (MDS). It provides an operational platform that enables the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and Combatant Commanders at strategic, regional, and tactical levels to plan missile defense operations, monitor battle progress, and actively control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission objectives. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities by providing optimized responses to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It also acts as a force multiplier by connecting, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous systems and operations worldwide.

As the Global Battle Management Product Owner – Software Engineer, you will lead a high-performing software development team to design, implement, and test innovative solutions that support MDA projects and experiments. You will combine strong software engineering skills (with a focus on Java and Unix/Linux) with product ownership responsibilities, ensuring that stakeholder needs are translated into clear, actionable requirements and that delivered capabilities meet those needs.

Essential Functions:

- Serve as the Product Owner and technical lead for the Global software development team, guiding the design, development, integration, and test of a large, distributed Java-based system
- Provide day-to-day leadership, direction, and mentorship to a cross-functional Agile software team, ensuring alignment to program priorities and mission needs
- Perform in-depth analysis and technical support of a large, distributed system written in Java, including complex problem resolution and performance optimization
- Provide technical consulting to the regional team and other stakeholders, helping to align Global and Regional capabilities and ensuring architectural and interface consistency
- Gather and refine requirements from stakeholders and other teams, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries that meet mission, operational, and test objectives
- Define and maintain acceptance criteria for team stories and product backlog items, ensuring the team has a clear understanding of what is required to complete work and demonstrate value
- Actively remove blockers at any level—technical, process, or coordination-related—to support team progress and maintain iteration and release commitments
- Assist the software team in design, implementation, testing, integration, and user support for a large and evolving code baseline
- Follow specifications and program priorities to develop, refine, and prioritize stories and tasks for the software team; maintain a well‑groomed and transparent product backlog
- Interface with other system support groups and software leadership to resolve problems, set standards, and improve the overall efficiency, performance, and maintainability of the system
- Support planning and execution of MDA projects and experiments, including non-standard work hours during event execution when required
- Collaborate closely with Government customers, subject matter experts, and system users to understand desired capabilities and communicate technical approaches, trade-offs, and results
- Adapt to rapidly changing requirements and design challenges, delivering high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines

Basic Qualifications:

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

- A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or 12 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
- Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Top Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
- Experience working as a software leader on a team in a role such as Scrum Master, Product Owner, or similar technical leadership position
- Knowledge of Agile principles, roles, and practices, with demonstrated experience applying Agile methods to software development
- Proficiency in Java , including the ability to design, develop, and test Java applications in a large-scale, distributed environment
- Experience developing in a Unix/Linux environment
- Strong understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming ( OOP ), design patterns, and testing/debugging techniques
- Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with developers, engineers, subject matter experts, and customers
- Ability to work effectively in a rapid-paced, team-oriented environment and within a structured development and configuration management framework
- Knowledge of software practices and coding standards, and the discipline to apply them consistently
- Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to review performance issues, identify root causes, recommend solutions, and drive implementation.

Preferred Qualifications:

The following knowledge and skills are highly desired for the Software Engineer / Product Owner:

- Experience with test-driven development ( TDD ) and continuous integration practices
- Background in software architecture design for complex, distributed systems
- Familiarity with Service-Oriented Architecture ( SOA ) development principles
- Ability to refactor code for reusability, readability, and maintainability in an object-oriented codebase
- Experience with application deployment, integration, and troubleshooting in operational or mission-critical environments
- Operating systems experience with both Windows and Unix/Linux platforms
- Experience with common development tools such as Eclipse IDE, Maven, and Git (or comparable tools)
- Experience conducting and participating in peer reviews for code, design, and documentation
- Ability to extract and analyze data to support system and performance analysis
- Strong written and oral communication skills, including the ability to clearly convey complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience implementing algorithms and developing messaging interface solutions in distributed systems
- Hands-on experience using Agile methodology for software development, including planning, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and retrospectives

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems has an opening for a Level 2 / Level 3 Technical Program Lead to work in Integrated Functional Capability (IFC) Management as a Systems Engineer and perform technical program leadership on the AISR&T program in Rancho Bernardo, CA . In this role, you will serve as a key integrator across engineering, integration/test, and program management, with primary responsibility for IFC Management and PI planning. You will coordinate scope, schedules, and technical content to ensure aligned deliveries across multiple teams.

Responsibilities
- Define and maintain IFC scope, content, and entry/exit criteria in coordination with engineering, integration, and program leadership.
- Align IFC builds with program milestones, lab/flight events, and customer deliveries; track readiness and drive closure of gaps and risks.
- Support PI planning and execution by helping define objectives, dependencies, and commitments that map to IFCs and program priorities.
- Act as a technical focal between systems, software, hardware, network, cyber, and integration labs to ensure end to end alignment.
- Contribute to technical roadmaps, schedules, and status for assigned IFCs and PIs, and communicate progress, issues, and risks to leadership.
- Track IFC readiness (requirements, design, implementation, integration, and test status) and drive closure of gaps and risks.
- Develop and maintain integrated plans and schedules for IFCs and PIs within assigned scope.

This role may be filled at either the Level 2 Engineer or Level 3 Engineer based on the qualifications below.

Basic Qualifications

As a Level 2 Engineer:
- Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least some of relevant military / professional / academic experience

As a Level 3 Principal Engineer:
- Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 5 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least 3 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a PhD and at least 1 year of relevant military / professional / academic experience

As an Engineer at Either Level:
- Must have an active US Government Secret or higher clearance (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in a systems engineer, technical project engineer, or technical program manager role on complex systems or DoW programs.
- Experience coordinating scope, schedule, and technical content across multiple teams or disciplines.
- Familiarity with configuration/increment planning (e.g., builds, drops, releases) and/or agile or PI planning practices.
- Experience managing or supporting IFC/release content for aerospace, defense, or other complex systems (e.g., mission systems, airborne ISR, tactical communications).
- Familiarity with requirements and configuration management tools (e.g., DOORS/DOORS Next, Jama, Teamcenter, Jira, or similar).
- Experience building and maintaining integrated schedules or technical roadmaps using tools such as MS Project or equivalent.
- Background in system integration, lab/rig integration, or system level test and the associated readiness/entry exit criteria.
- Experience in risk and issue management, including tracking, reporting, and mitigation planning on technical programs.
- Strong communication, organization, and facilitation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, integration/test, and program management.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

As an Staff Infrastructure Product Owner (DevOps) , you will be supporting our Software and Electronics/Payloads Department which has ~200 Software Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Systems Administrators, Database Administrators, Network Engineers, and Engineering Leaders from entry-level to the most senior chief engineers and architects to Product Owners and Scrum Masters. This engineering organization supports numerous programs across Divisions and Business Units of the Space Sector. We have opportunities for career advancement into higher level technical roles or leadership positions over one’s career.

This role will be located at our Aurora, CO or Morrisville, NC office location .  On this team, you’ll be a linchpin in missions of paramount importance, defining the art of the possible from day one.

The ideal candidate must have relevant DevOps experience and prior Agile Product Owner experience to join a small team as their Product Owner.

Basic Qualifications (must have/required to be considered):
- Must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret security clearance at time of application, current and within scope, with the ability to obtain and maintain SCI approval/access.
- United States Citizenship
- Bachelor’s degree with 12 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 8 years of professional experience – OR PhD with 6 years of professional experience. An additional 4+ years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
- DevOps Engineering experience including CI/CD pipeline deployment
- Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Gitlab Pipelines, and Scripting
- Experience with Terraform and environment initialization
- Prior Agile experience in either a Product Owner or Scrum Master role
- Prior leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications (not required, but nice to have):
- An active CI or FS Polygraph or have held a Polygraph within the last 24 months
- Current and active Security+ and CISSP certifications
- Prior engineering experience within the Space Industry
- Excellent presentation, communication, technical writing, and organization skills
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Experience sharing knowledge via mentoring, coaching, or training others
- Experience with developing and deploying CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins or GitLab
- Experience with deployment automation scripting using Helm or Ansible or related products
- Experience troubleshooting virtualization, automation, and deployment applications such as Flux CD, Grafana, Athena, Prometheus, Karpenter or related products
- Experience with Linux Operating Systems Preferably RHEL 8/9
- Knowledge of basic networking principles (subnets, VLANs, routing, and firewalls)
